headline: Taylor and Van Barneveld to captain Rivals Reunited at Ally Pally
standfirst: The two former world champions will lead teams in an exhibition at Alexandra Palace on 10 December, the night before the World Championship begins.
body: Phil Taylor and Raymond van Barneveld are to renew their famous rivalry at Alexandra Palace in a one-off exhibition called Rivals Reunited: Taylor v Barney, staged on Thursday 10 December.

Neither man will throw. Instead each will act as captain of a team made up of former world champions and celebrity guests, with the sides competing for a Rivals Reunited trophy. The format of the contests has not yet been spelled out.
Taylor has so far named Adrian Lewis, Jordan North and the singer Woody in his line-up. Van Barneveld's side includes John Part, Chris Stark and Lloyd Griffith. Further names are due to be announced.

The event falls on the eve of the PDC World Championship and will be held in the Great Hall at Alexandra Palace. The venue is a larger space than the one used for recent tournaments and is being treated as a test run for the championship's move there.

Taylor was quoted as saying the "competitive instinct never goes away", while Van Barneveld suggested his old rival would want to win as badly as he does. PDC chief executive Matt Porter described the night as a chance for supporters to enjoy an evening ahead of the main event.
Five pounds from every ticket sold will go to Prostate Cancer UK. Ticket prices and broadcast arrangements had not been confirmed in the sources available.
